concern: (low) Touch target bounding boxes on mobile tag badges should be verified for 44x44px minimum tap target compliance in upcoming component refinements.
jtbd: When interacting with tag badges on mobile touch screens, I want each interactive badge to provide a minimum 44x44px touch bounding target, so that I can reliably activate filters without triggering adjacent elements or suffering interaction errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a mobile viewport (375px), When inspecting the interactive tag badges within the hero metadata section, Then each touch target bounding area measures at least 44x44 CSS pixels in compliance with WCAG 2.5.5 / 2.5.8 Target Size requirements.
editInstruction: In design/approved/20261110013013-mockup/mockup.html, update the tag badges in the hero section container (div.flex.flex-wrap.gap-2.pt-1) to ensure 44x44px tap target compliance by adding 'min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] inline-flex items-center justify-center' while preserving pill badge typography and visual padding.

concern: (low) Form control archetype options should be dynamically bound to institutional role catalog in next sprint cycle.
